Name: Pict Provider Vocabulary
Tagline: Pict provider for vocabulary/glossary term management — holds a term index, provides a resolver callback for pict-section-content's parseMarkdown auto-linking, and wires popover hover handlers on rendered terms. Works with any term source: filesystem, database, or API.
